name: 奥德丽·洛德

identity.findings: 站内条目实指加勒比裔美国诗人-散文家-活动家 Audre Lorde（1934-1992，已故）：legacy 书目《姐妹局外人/异教徒》《Zami》《癌症日记》均为其作品，黑人女性主义定位无误。身份本身成立，但 legacy 生平细节多处错误：①『执教于约翰·霍普金斯大学』查无实据，已读来源作 Tougaloo College（1968）、John Jay College of Criminal Justice 与 Hunter College（均纽约市立大学系统）、柏林自由大学客座（1984），无任何霍普金斯记载；②『1992年因肝癌去世』——已读三来源（poets.org、Catt Center、柏林年纪录片站）均作乳腺癌/泛称癌症，未读来源支持『肝癌』死因表述（通行传记作1986年肝转移，本轮未核到直接来源）；③『1954年至1959年间在亨特学院学习图书馆学』表述存疑，已读来源仅作『亨特学院学士、哥伦比亚大学图书馆学硕士』（无年份）；④『幼年法定盲』本轮已读来源均未提及，仅作线索保留。任务提示称『IEP 有专条』：经核查 IEP 字母 L 索引页与站内检索（?s=lorde、?s=audre）均无 Audre Lorde 专条，仅其他条目引用其『主人的工具』语句——如实记录为提示与事实不符。
legacyIssues: legacy『执教于纽约城市大学、约翰·霍普金斯大学等高校』：霍普金斯查无实据，全废；实据为 Tougaloo、John Jay、Hunter、柏林自由大学客座
legacy『1992年因肝癌去世』：已读来源均作乳腺癌/癌症泛称，肝癌表述不采（通行传记作1986年肝转移，本轮未核）
legacy『1954年至1959年间在亨特学院学习图书馆学』：已读来源无此年份与专业表述，不采；仅作『亨特学院学士、哥伦比亚大学图书馆学硕士』
legacy『幼年时因视力问题被诊断为法定盲』：本轮已读来源未提及，不写入草稿，留线索
legacy 译名自相矛盾：《姐妹异教徒》与《姐妹局外人》并存，统一按提示用《姐妹外来者》并注原题
legacy『Zami 被视作交叉性叙事的经典文本』：体裁按其本人定义为 biomythography（传记神话志），不采交叉性叙事定性
legacy『为朱迪斯·巴特勒的性别操演理论提供非本质主义分析路径』：无据（无文献支持且年代牵强），全废
legacy 9 条 context 关系（黑人哲学流派摘录：杜波依斯/法农/道格拉斯/科恩/科林斯/韦斯特/戴维斯/阿桑特/卡迈克尔）：流派摘抄产物，本包不保留；关系按新读来源重建
legacy 书目四条均无年份/出版社/kind，逐条补全并核正（《愤怒与爱》对应 Cables to Rage 旧译，本轮按原题与出版社重录）
legacy overview『这一理论后来被金伯莉·克伦肖系统化』：改为接受史追认表述，不写『系统化了洛德的理论』

sources.title: Academy of American Poets · Audre Lorde
sources.readScope: 全文已读：生于1934-02-18纽约市，本名 Audrey Geraldine Lorde，父母为来自格林纳达的移民，三姐妹中最小，天主教学校，中学时首诗刊于《Seventeen》；亨特学院学士、哥伦比亚大学图书馆学硕士；1961-1968年任纽约公立学校图书馆员；1962年嫁 Edward Rollins，育 Elizabeth 与 Jonathon，1970年离异；1968年 Tougaloo College 驻校作家并发现教学之爱、于此结识终身伴侣 Frances Clayton；书目：The First Cities（Poets Press, 1968）、Cables to Rage（Paul Breman, 1970）、From a Land Where Other People Live（Broadside Press, 1973，国家图书奖提名）、The New York Head Shop and Museum（Broadside, 1974）、Between Our Selves（Eidolon, 1976）、Coal（Norton, 1976）、The Black Unicorn（Norton, 1978——该页年表误作1995）、Chosen Poems Old and New（Norton, 1982）、Undersong（Norton, 1992）、The Marvelous Arithmetics of Distance（Norton, 1993）、The Collected Poems（Norton, 1997）；The Cancer Journals（1980，获1981 Gay Caucus Book of the Year）、Zami（Crossing Press, 1982）、Sister Outsider（Crossing Press, 1984）、A Burst of Light（Firebrand, 1988，『won a National Book Award』）；1981年 NEA 奖金；1980年代与 Barbara Smith 创办 Kitchen Table: Women of Color Press；Sisters in Support of Sisters in South Africa 创始成员；1991-92年『纽约州桂冠诗人』；2021年入祀圣约翰大教堂 American Poets Corner；『died of breast cancer in 1992』。该页无柏林记载。

sources.title: Poetry Foundation · Audre Lorde
sources.readScope: 经网页阅读服务获取全文（直接抓取被403拦截，如实记录）：自我描述 'black, lesbian, mother, warrior, poet'；父母为西印度移民；入学亨特学院附中，中学时在 Seventeen 发表诗作；书目年表自 The First Cities（1968）起（From a Land Where Other People Live 作1972年——与 poets.org 的1973出入）；1972年与 Frances Clayton 开始长期伴侣关系（与 poets.org 系于 Tougaloo 时期相出入，两说并存）；经典论文该页拼作 'The Master's Tools Will Not Dismantle the Master's House'（与通行 'Will Never Dismantle' 略异）；The Cancer Journals（1980）；Zami 出版方称其为 'biomythography'；Sister Outsider: Essays and Speeches（1984）；A Burst of Light（1988，该页称『won the National Book Award』）；1981年与 Moraga、Smith 创办 Kitchen Table: Women of Color Press（与 poets.org 的1980年代表述有出入）；Sisterhood in Support of Sisters in South Africa；曾任教 John Jay College 与 Hunter College 英语教授；1991-92纽约州桂冠诗人；Alexis De Veaux《Warrior Poet》(2006)为首部全传；转引 Adrienne Rich 对《黑独角兽》的公开评语与 Joan Martin、Allison Kimmich 的评论（『差异……必须成为庆祝与成长的理由』）。

sources.title: Iowa State University Catt Center, Archive of Women's Political Communication · “The Master's Tools Will Never Dismantle the Master's House”
sources.readScope: 全文已读：演讲信息——『comments at “The Personal and the Political” panel at the Second Sex Conference at New York University on September 29, 1979』；生卒信息——1934-02-18生于纽约市，加勒比移民之女；亨特学士、哥大图书馆学硕士；图书馆员；Tougaloo 驻校诗人；John Jay 与 Hunter 教授；1991年纽约州桂冠诗人；『Lorde died of breast cancer on November 17, 1992, in St. Croix, U.S. Virgin Islands』；演讲原文关键段落：『For the master's tools will never dismantle the master's house. They may allow us temporarily to beat him at his own game, but they will never enable us to bring about genuine change』；『Difference must be not merely tolerated, but seen as a fund of necessary polarities between which our creativity can spark like a dialectic』；『Advocating the mere tolerance of difference between women is the grossest reformism』。用于身份、生卒死因、master's tools 概念归属与文本引语。

sources.title: University of Illinois（Women and Development 课程页）· Lorde, “The Master's Tools Will Never Dismantle the Master's House” 全文 PDF
sources.readScope: 全文（3页）已读：开篇自述『I agreed to take part in a New York University Institute for the Humanities conference a year ago, with the understanding that I would be commenting upon papers dealing with the role of difference within the lives of American women: difference of race, sexuality, class, and age』；『I stand here as a Black lesbian feminist, having been invited to comment within the only panel at this conference where the input of Black feminists and lesbians is represented』；『survival is not an academic skill』；『the master's tools will never dismantle the master's house』；对『替你打扫房间带孩子、却进不了会场』的 poor women and women of Color 的质问；文内转引 Adrienne Rich 近期演讲。用于 master's tools 论证内容与大会语境（NYU Institute for the Humanities 会议）。

sources.title: Universiteit Antwerpen 藏 Sister Outsider 扫描件（“Uses of the Erotic: The Erotic as Power”，Crossing Press Feminist Series）
sources.readScope: 扫描件（The Crossing Press / Freedom, CA；San Francisco State University 藏）首页至第4页已读：头注『Paper delivered at the Fourth Berkshire Conference on the History of Women, Mount Holyoke College. August 25, 1978. Published as a pamphlet by Out & Out Books (available from The Crossing Press)』；原文关键段：『The erotic is a resource within each of us that lies in a deeply female and spiritual plane, firmly rooted in the power of our unexpressed or unrecognized feeling』；『But pornography is a direct denial of the power of the erotic, for it represents the suppression of true feeling. Pornography emphasizes sensation without feeling』；『For the erotic is not a question only of what we do; it is a question of how acutely and fully we can feel in the doing』；以及对卓越（excellence）的内在要求。用于 erotic 概念归属（篇目+宣读时间地点+小册子出版）与文本引语。

sources.title: Monoskop 影印 The Cancer Journals（2nd ed., spinsters/aunt lute, San Francisco；含初版版权页影印）
sources.readScope: 版权页与正文关键页已读：LC 在版编目『The cancer journals / Audre Lorde.—1st ed.—Argyle, N.Y.: Spinsters, Ink, cl980. 77 p.』；『Sections I and II of this book originally appeared in Sinister Wisdom』；致谢页列 Maureen Brady, Frances Clayton, Michelle Cliff, Blanche Cook, Clare Coss, Judith McDaniel, Adrienne Rich；结构：导言（post-mastectomy woman 的发声宣言，『silence has never brought us anything of worth』）+ 日记（2/5/79 起）+ Section I『The Transformation of Silence into Language and Action』（以献给温妮·曼德拉的诗开场）+ Section II『Breast Cancer: A Black Lesbian Feminist Experience』（1978-03-25、10-10 日记）+『Breast Cancer: Power vs. Prosthesis』（『On Labor Day, 1978, during my regular monthly self-examination, I discovered a lump in my right breast which later proved to be malignant』；对整形外科『look decent in clothes』论与美国癌症学会的批评；Moishe Dayan 眼罩对照段）；封底作者简介：『She teaches at John Jay College of Criminal Justice』、《黑独角兽》1978由 Norton 出版。用于癌症经历事实层、书目著录、Rich/Clayton 关系佐证。注意：IA 同书元数据目录曾作『A trip to the beach』，与扫描件实文不符，弃用。

sources.title: Internet Archive 目录页 · Sister outsider: essays and speeches (Crossing Press, 1984)
sources.readScope: 经网页阅读服务获取（部分字段抓取不稳定，如实记录）：1984年 Trumansburg, N.Y.: Crossing Press，ix+190p；目录可见『Notes from a trip to Russia / Poetry is not a luxury / The transformation of silence into language and action / Scratching the surface / Sexism: an American disease in blackface / An open letter to Mary Daly / Uses of the erotic / The master's tools will never dismantle the master's house / Tar Beach / The uses of anger: women responding to racism / Learning from the 60s / … Grenada revisited / Eye to eye: black women, hatred, and anger / Interview with Audre Lorde（Introduction by Adrienne Rich）』。用于 Sister Outsider 书目与篇目归属（Poetry Is Not a Luxury、Uses of Anger、Open Letter to Mary Daly 均在集中）。

sources.title: 纪录片官网 Audre Lorde – The Berlin Years 1984 to 1992（Dagmar Schultz）首页与 The Berlin Years 页
sources.readScope: 首页与 /berlin-years 已读：『From 1984 to 1992 Audre Lorde spent weeks and months at a time in Berlin giving readings and at the same time seeking naturopathic treatment for her cancer illness』；她赋予 Afro-German 女性力量、挑战白人女性的白人特权，May Ayim、Katharina Oguntoye、Ika Hügel-Marshall 相继出版；『Audre's diagnosis of terminal cancer left her American doctors without hope』，柏林成为第三故乡；片长79分钟、2012年第62届柏林电影节首映；『In 1991 Audre Lorde received the Walt Whitman Citation of Merit, which named her as Poet of the State of New York from 1991 to 1993』；『Audre Lorde died at the age of 58, in her house in St. Croix in 1992, after 14 years of struggle with cancer』；15卷诗集、ZAMI biomythography、Cancer Journals 与 Sister Outsider。

sources.title: 同站 Press Kit（含导演 Dagmar Schultz 自述）
sources.readScope: 全文已读：『Dagmar Schultz … organized an invitation from the Free University of Berlin for Lorde to come and teach there as a visiting professor in 1984』；Schultz 自述『In the spring of 1984, she agreed to come to Berlin for a semester to teach literature and creative writing』；洛德到柏林问『Where are the Black Germans?』；她『initiated work on the book Showing Our Colors. Afro-German Women Speak Out』（Orlanda Frauenverlag, 1986 出版）。用于柏林自由大学1984客座教职与 Afro-German 运动的发起。

sources.title: 同站 Study Guide（Marion Kraft 编，英/德双语）
sources.readScope: PDF 全文已读：Further readings 著录『Showing Our Colors. Afro-German Women Speak Out. Edited by May Opitz, Katharina Oguntoye & Dagmar Schultz. Translated by Anne V. Adams. Foreword by Audre Lorde. The University of Massachusetts Press, 1992』——洛德为英译本作序；May Ayim《Hope in My Heart》纪录片条目；Kraft《The African Continuum…》含洛德专章。用于 Showing Our Colors 的英文版信息与洛德作序。

sources.title: LibreTexts Social Sciences 开放教材 · 2.4: Intersectionality
sources.readScope: 全文已读：交叉性一词『largely recognized as being coined in 1989 by professor of law, Dr. Kimberlé Crenshaw』（源于对美国黑人女性遭受歧视的法律案件分析：种族与性别被分开处理）；洛德一节——她『also wrote about intersectionality』，在《Age, Race, Class, and Sex: Redefining Difference》(1980) 中批评西方社会以『simplistic, hierarchical, and binary oppositions』理解差异，提出『mythical norm』（'white, thin, male, young, heterosexual, christian, and financially secure'），并拒绝被要求『pluck out some one aspect』的自我的『destructive and fragmenting way to live』。用于 mythical norm 概念内容与洛德-克伦肖概念史衔接。

sources.title: University of Chicago Unbound · Crenshaw, “Demarginalizing the Intersection of Race and Sex…” 落地页（U. Chi. Legal F., 1989, Art. 8）
sources.readScope: 落地页已读（全文 PDF 被反爬拦截，如实记录访问范围）：题名 'Demarginalizing the Intersection of Race and Sex: A Black Feminist Critique of Antidiscrimination Doctrine, Feminist Theory and Antiracist Politics'，作者 Kimberle Crenshaw，University of Chicago Legal Forum Vol.1989 Article 8。用于克伦肖1989年文献著录；文内是否引用洛德未核（PDF 不可读）。

sources.readScope: 引文页已读（弱来源，如实标注）：『When Audre Lorde made that much quoted yet often misunderstood cautionary statement warning us that “the master's tools will never dismantle the master's house”…』，页面将其归属 hooks《Talking Back: Thinking Feminist, Thinking Black》（未注年份；具体篇章未核，原书页面未读）。仅用于 hooks 与洛德的接受关系线索，不作为强证据。
